'''TB-2''' was a [[2-1B surgical droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic]], stationed as a [[medic]] aboard the [[freighter]] ''[[Twilight]]'' during the [[Clone Wars]]. Originally a [[hologram]],<ref name="TCW film" /> they were uploaded into a body and continued to serve aboard [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s freighter, as well as on his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|Republic Star Destroyer]] ''[[Resolute]]''.<ref name="Helmet Collection 58">{{HelmetCollectionCite|58|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref>

==Biography==
[[File:Wolffe_recovers.png|thumb|left|200px|TB-2 tends to Commander Wolffe aboard the ''Twilight''.]]
After the [[Battle of Teth]], [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his new [[Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano]] communicated with TB-2 via [[hologram]] to diagnose the [[Hutt]]let [[Rotta]]'s failing health.<ref name="TCW film" /> Following the rescue of [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]], [[Wolffe]], [[Sergeant]] [[Sinker]], and [[Boost]] after the [[Battle of Abregado]], TB-2 aided the injured [[clone trooper]]s aboard the ''[[Twilight]]'', stabilizing them for transport to a [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigate]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> During the [[Battle of Ryloth]], TB-2 was stationed in the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute|''Resolute'']]. He helped cure the injured [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]], who was wounded during the attempt to break the blockade of the planet.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}
